A man knocked down one wall in his basement... and found a city underneath his village.
Behind the wall, cold air was coming out of the dark.
He took a lamp, and crawled inside.
A tunnel. Then stairs. Then another tunnel... going down.
Stables. Kitchens. Wells. Whole rooms carved out of solid rock.
Eight levels. Eighty five meters deep. Room for twenty thousand people.
And on every level, a giant stone door... that only closes from the inside.
Because this city was not built to live in. It was built to hide.
When raiders came, the whole town simply disappeared underground.
The raiders found empty houses... and silence.
Today, thousands of people walk over Derinkuyu every day.
And no one knows how many more cities are still sleeping under their feet... maybe behind the next basement wall.
